title: Put Amber Iman in more shows in general actually #offbroadway #theatr...
transcript: goddess may honestly be my favourite musical that I've ever seen at the public I loved this now goddess is loosely adapted from Kenyan mythology and marimba the goddess of music and in the musical marimba goes to a jazz club in Kenya and meets Omari a young man who has just returned home from America both of them have really big legacies set down by their parents Marimba's mother the goddess of evil has declared marimba as the goddess of war and Marimba's like I don't really wanna do that I actually wanna be the goddess of music Omari's father is the governor of Kenya who is about to retire and he wants Omari to take over as governor and he's also like really super conservative and Omari is like hmm I don't know if I really wanna do that I kinda just wanna play music Omari and marimba meet have an obvious connection and the musical takes off from there and this production one absolutely stunning the scenic design the lighting design there are puppets in this there was a moment with puppets that like literally I gasped in the theater it was just so cool and especially the use of puppetry to reenact to the more mythological aspects of the show I thought was incredibly well done I really loved the music in this especially when you had the whole and the band was on stage because a lot of this takes place in a jazz club even the costume designs in this were just absolutely stunning like the overall design of this production 10 out of 10 and the cast is absolutely incredible I mean obviously you have this LED by Amber Iman who's just so talented and her voice is perfect for the goddess of music but this entire cast all the way down through the ensemble is just so incredibly talented on that stage and the choreography by Darrell Moultry and direction by Saheem Ali do a really great job of blending the multiple locations throughout the musical numbers um and just the the way that the transitions happened was really well done there's one major miss from this musical though and you guessed it it's the book the book needs work but to be honest I was expecting that because originally the book writer on this musical when it was in Berkeley was Jocelyn Bioh who I was really excited to see her book uh she left the project due to some sort of creative differences that she posted about publicly and that happened like literally two months ago so I did not expect that any of the issues with the book were going to be fixed and surely enough they are not but the first act shows a lot of promise and overall I think the show is fixable again I saw Suffs at the public that went through way more changes before going to Broadway I think the changes that goddess needs to make are absolutely doable the overall arc is there I see where the show is trying to end up and the story that it is trying to tell with these two characters I think that's solid it just does not know how to tie the the ends together at the end yet and that's really what this musical needs is that like nice little tied together ending I could talk a little bit more in depth on my thoughts about this show but it's gonna start getting into spoiler territory so I'll leave you with that the book needs work especially the second act but what is there is incredibly solid and the overall production really well done as far as tickets go I was invited to this so huge thank you to the public there is a digital rush available on today ticks though for 48 dollar tickets I will say if you are choosing where to sit in the theater there's definitely no sightline issues but be aware that there is a fountain that is running stage right house left so if the sound of that is going to bother you then I would avoid sitting close to that uh because it is it is rather loud I can hear it a little bit from where I was sitting across the theatre um but you probably maybe won't be able to hear it in the back but if you're sitting close to it you will definitely be able to hear it so just keep that in mind goddess is currently only playing at the public through June I cannot recommend this enough and I really I really hope this one transfers I think I think you could have a life on Broadway and especially for my mythology nerds out there if you like mythology shows this this one's for you
